[LLEX.10.8.2] **NFC at lex time.** The lexer must NFC-normalize a `NAME` before
interning, comparison, and emission ([LNAM.2.4]); it must not normalize
string-literal content ([LNAM.2.7]). All Unicode work — legality and NFC — is
compile-time; the runtime carries no Unicode tables ([LNAM.2.2.5]).
